admin.denied.unauthorized.title: Sign in to the app

admin.denied.mfa_required.title: Two-factor authentication required
admin.denied.mfa_required.text: Turn on two-factor authentication on Discord (User Settings, My Account, Enable Authenticator App), then sign out of the app and sign in again.
admin.typeId: To confirm, type their Discord id

admin.err.banDays: The duration goes from 1 to 3650 days, or permanent.
admin.err.reason: The reason is required (500 characters max).
admin.err.noteBody: The note must be 1 to 2000 characters long.
admin.err.bootstrapRequired: Only a founder admin can name or remove admins.
admin.err.changeSelf: You cannot change your own Admin role.
admin.err.bootstrapAdmin: Founder admins are managed only in the server configuration.

admin.err.banAdmin: Admins cannot be banned: remove the Admin role first.
admin.err.deleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
admin.err.deleteAdmin: Admins cannot be deleted: remove the Admin role first.

admin.patreon.noneText: Members appear here when Patreon sends its first update.
admin.patreon.noResults: No member matches the search and filter.
admin.audit.filterHint: The id is on the account page, next to the name.
admin.audit.emptyTarget: No actions recorded on this account.
admin.key.name: Name
admin.u.notFoundText: The account does not exist or has been deleted.
admin.u.grantForever: Manual plan {tier} with no end date
admin.u.rankDebugger: Debugger turns on the debug and packet logs in the app.
admin.u.rankPlayer: Access goes back to the normal rules (trial, Patreon).
admin.u.trialDeveloper: Does not apply to Developer accounts.
admin.u.ineligible: Discord account under 8 months: not eligible for the automatic trial.
admin.u.endOnlyRunning: End now is only available with a running trial.
admin.u.extendHint: From 1 to 365. They add to the current end, or start now if the trial is over or never started. Applies to the account and all its PCs, even if not eligible.
admin.u.endText: The trial of {name} ends immediately, on all their PCs.
admin.u.restartText: A full 30-day trial starts now for {name}, valid on all their PCs.
admin.u.adminBootstrap: Founder admin: changed only in the server configuration (ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS).
admin.u.adminOn: Has access to this panel and all its actions.
admin.u.adminOff: Gives full access to this panel. Needs confirmation with the Discord id.
admin.u.grantText: {name} will be able to open this panel, see every account and take every action except naming other admins.
admin.u.revokeText: {name} loses access to the panel immediately.
admin.u.noCharactersText: They come from fights uploaded with app 0.4.4 or later.
admin.u.pcsCount: {n} of {max} allowed PCs in the last 30 days.
admin.u.resetPcsText: The PCs of {name} are forgotten: the next ones that open the app register again, up to the limit of the plan.
admin.u.noSessions: No session open in the app.
admin.u.closeSessionsText: {name} is signed out of the app on every PC ({n} sessions) and must sign in with Discord again.
admin.u.banText: Signed out of the app at once; their logs disappear from rankings and public pages while it lasts.
admin.u.banDaysHint: From 1 to 3650. The ban ends by itself.
admin.u.banEffect: Signed out at once, cannot sign in again, and their logs disappear from rankings, class stats and public pages while it lasts.
admin.u.unbanText: They can sign in again at once. The ban stays in the history.
admin.u.unbanConfirmText: {name} can sign in again at once and their logs become visible again.
admin.u.exportText: Downloads as JSON everything we hold on the account. The export is logged.
admin.u.deleteText: Irreversible: logs, PCs, sessions and notes are deleted.
admin.u.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the account of {name}, its {n} logs, PCs, sessions and notes. Only the trial fingerprint and the log entry remain.
admin.u.deleteExportHint: If you need a copy, export the data before deleting.
